hikes.name: Mount Adams South Climb
hikes.blurb: Washington's second-highest peak without ropes for most: a long snow climb past the Lunch Counter to a flat 12,276-foot summit (climbing permit).

hikes.name: Killen Creek to High Camp
hikes.blurb: Up meadows on Adams' north side to a high bench right under the Adams Glacier's icefall.

hikes.name: Bird Creek Meadows
hikes.blurb: Wildflower meadows and waterfalls on Yakama Nation land, to a rim above Hellroaring Canyon and the Mazama Glacier.

hikes.name: Thomas Lake and Indian Heaven Lakes
hikes.blurb: Into Indian Heaven's maze of lakes and huckleberry meadows on a gentle volcanic plateau.

hikes.name: Sleeping Beauty
hikes.blurb: A short, steep climb to an old lookout site on a rock knob facing Mt Adams.

hikes.name: Sawtooth Mountain
hikes.blurb: Above the huckleberry fields to a jagged ridge with Adams, St Helens, Rainier and Hood.

hikes.name: Elk Peak
hikes.blurb: From Cody Day Use Trailhead, an 11.4-mile round trip to the top of Elk Peak (5,518 ft), with about 2,700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: South Butte
hikes.blurb: From Bird Lake Trailhead, a 10.1-mile round trip to the top of South Butte (7,637 ft), with about 2,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lake Wapiki
hikes.blurb: From Filloon Trailhead, a 6.9-mile round trip to Lake Wapiki, with about 1,500 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: The Bumper
hikes.blurb: From Stagman Ridge Trailhead, an 11.5-mile round trip to the top of The Bumper (6,087 ft), with about 2,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Nannie Peak
hikes.blurb: From Walupt Lake Trailhead, a 5.5-mile round trip to the top of Nannie Peak (6,128 ft), with about 2,200 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Steamboat Lake
hikes.blurb: From Grand Meadows Trailhead, a 4.6-mile round trip to Steamboat Lake, with about 850 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Little Goose Lake
hikes.blurb: From Lemei Trailhead, a 5.0-mile round trip to Little Goose Lake, with about 650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Little Mount Adams
hikes.blurb: From Bluff Lake Trailhead, an 11.7-mile round trip to the top of Little Mount Adams (6,789 ft), with about 3,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sheep Lake
hikes.blurb: From Riley Camp Trailhead, a 9.9-mile round trip to Sheep Lake, with about 2,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lookingglass Lake
hikes.blurb: From Stagman Ridge Trailhead, an 8.7-mile round trip to Lookingglass Lake, with about 2,000 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Pocket Lake
hikes.blurb: From KIllen Creek Trailhead, a 9.0-mile round trip to Pocket Lake, with about 1,900 feet of climbing.
